title: Disruptive Raises $10B for New AI and Defense Technology Fund
summary:
A Dallas-based investment firm has established a new capital pool to back category-leading private technology companies focusing on compute infrastructure and software. The Disruptive Flagship Fund will target approximately 10 growth and late-stage companies, with the firm planning to deploy as much as $1B per individual investment to support companies that are remaining private longer.

The $10B fund doubles Disruptive's assets under management and shifts the firm's operational model from single-deal special purpose vehicles to a discretionary fund structure. Founded in 2012, the firm said the increased scale is necessary to meet the rising capital requirements of strategic companies in the artificial intelligence and national security sectors.

selectedTweets.text:
Today, we announced the Disruptive Flagship Fund, a $10 billion fund designed to scale the firm’s selective approach to backing category-leading private technology companies.

Advances in artificial intelligence, the massive buildout of compute infrastructure, and a new era of investment in defense and national security are creating companies of unprecedented scale and strategic importance. The amount of capital required to capture these opportunities is increasing significantly.

Disruptive was built for this moment. Since its founding in 2012, the firm has developed an investment model designed to identify a small number of exceptional companies and deploy significant capital behind them.

Disruptive’s investment approach remains unchanged and the firm plans to back approximately 10 exceptional growth and late-stage companies, investing up to $1 billion per company.

Alex Davis, Founder and CEO of Disruptive commented: “The best private technology companies are growing larger, staying private longer and requiring more capital than ever before. We have always focused on a small number of exceptional companies, building the conviction and relationships to be there for founders at their most important moments. The Disruptive Flagship Fund gives us the scale to match the opportunity.”
